title: Irresponsible Mom Arrested After Bringing a Toddler To The Bar
description:
On August 22nd, 2021. Police responded to a call regarding an intoxicated woman at the bar with her 4-year-old toddler. According to staff and witnesses, the toddler was without shoes & allegedly lifting her skirt to customers in the bar. This is the body-cam footage of the events.
